newsitem.title: USA: US blue chips up, led by United Tech.
newsitem.headline: US blue chips up, led by United Tech.

text.p: The Dow industrials moved modestly higher in early business on Monday while other U.S. stocks were generally steady in early activity.
Analyst said the session, the last of the third quarter, was likely to be dominated by window dressing activity.
The Dow industrials rose 16 points to 5888 and the Nasdaq Composite was off fractionally to 1230. The Standard & Poor's 500 index rose one point to 687.
Among U.S. blue chips, United Technologies gained 1-1/4 to 121-1/2 after the company said its board approved a two-for-one stock split.
